supplements.title: The orexinergic system mediates the effects of ginsenoside Rg1 against cyclophosphamide-induced reproductive toxicity.
supplements.summary: Ginsenoside Rg1 protects male mice from chemotherapy-induced infertility by activating a specific cellular receptor in the testes.

supplements.title: Chemical constituents and anti-ulcer effects of a wild pear (Pyrus syriaca Boiss.): Phytochemical, histopathological and apoptotic approaches.
supplements.summary: Wild pear extract protects against gastric ulcers by reducing inflammation, oxidative stress, and cell death in rats.

supplements.title: Chitosan-mediated nano-bioprocessing of Acacia seyal seed extract for enhanced antineoplastic, anti-Helicobacter pylori and antioxidant performance.
supplements.summary: Acacia seyal extract wrapped in chitosan nanoparticles effectively kills colorectal cancer cells and fights H. pylori bacteria.

supplements.title: Aromatic amino acid metabolism shapes autophagy-mediated adaptation to iron deprivation in glioblastoma cells.
supplements.summary: Iron deprivation triggers protective autophagy in glioblastoma, which can be blocked by supplementing aromatic amino acids to enhance cell death.

supplements.title: Repurposing rosmarinic acid as an anti-colorectal cancer agent through bolstering T cell anti-tumor immunity by enhancing activation of MEK1-mediated TCR signaling.
supplements.summary: Rosmarinic acid, a natural compound, strengthens immune T cells against colorectal cancer by enhancing their signaling pathways and tumor-fighting ability.

supplements.title: S-equol promotes ferroptosis in triple negative breast cancer by coordinating NCOA4-mediated ferritinophagy and PPARγ-mediated lipid metabolism.
supplements.summary: S-equol kills triple negative breast cancer cells by triggering ferroptosis through iron accumulation and lipid damage pathways.

supplements.title: Glycyrrhizic Acid Alleviates Osimertinib-Induced Cutaneous Toxicity by Inhibiting Keratinocyte Apoptosis and Inflammation.
supplements.summary: Glycyrrhizic acid reduces skin damage from osimertinib, a lung cancer drug, by decreasing inflammation and cell death in mice.

supplements.title: Shenling Baizhu Powder Alleviated Lung Damage and Enhanced Immunoregulatory Activity in Mice with Non-Tuberculosis Mycobacterial Lung Disease.
supplements.summary: A traditional herbal powder called Shenling Baizhu Powder reduced lung damage and boosted immune function in mice with mycobacterial lung disease.

supplements.title: Dihydroartemisinin Induces Ferroptosis in Ovarian Cancer via STAT3/GPX4 Signaling Pathway.
supplements.summary: A drug called dihydroartemisinin kills ovarian cancer cells by triggering a specific type of cell death through a particular signaling pathway.

supplements.title: Mechanistic Topology of Notopterygium incisum Essential Oil against Rheumatoid Arthritis: Machine Learning-Guided CASP1 Screening and Nanoemulsion Evaluation.
supplements.summary: Researchers identified compounds in Notopterygium incisum essential oil that reduce rheumatoid arthritis inflammation and created a nanoemulsion to improve drug delivery.

supplements.title: LC/MS-Based Phytochemical Profiling and Immunomodulatory Evaluation of Three Medicinal Plants With Anticancer and Antibacterial Activities.
supplements.summary: Three medicinal plant extracts showed promise against breast cancer cells and antibiotic-resistant bacteria through antioxidant and immune-boosting compounds.

supplements.title: Early-Onset Colorectal Cancer: New Risk Factors or More of the Same at Earlier Ages?
supplements.summary: Colorectal cancer in people under 50 is increasing due to both new bacteria and rising obesity, poor diet, and inactivity in younger generations.

supplements.title: Effect of Bendiocarb Administration on Oxidative Stress and Caspase-3/Caspase-9/Bax/Bcl-2/p53 Mediated Apoptosis: The Role of Chrysin.
supplements.summary: Chrysin reduced oxidative stress and liver cell death caused by bendiocarb exposure in rats.

supplements.title: Tomatidine is a senotherapeutic compound that improves cognitive function and reduces cellular senescence in aged mice.
supplements.summary: Tomatidine, a tomato compound, reduces cellular aging markers and improves cognitive function and movement in aged mice.

supplements.title: Combining 5-ALA-PDT with berbamine as an in vitro multimodal therapy approach against bladder cancer cells.
supplements.summary: Combining light therapy with a plant compound called berbamine effectively kills bladder cancer cells, including drug-resistant variants.

off_label.title: Aging-dependent microglial heterogeneity worsens outcomes in models of traumatic brain injury.
off_label.summary: Aged brains develop harmful immune cells after traumatic injury, but blocking a protein called ELF1 or using an existing drug restores protective immunity and improves recovery.

off_label.title: Metformin drives HIF-1α-mediated dual metabolic reprogramming to enhance γδ T cell therapy in triple-negative breast cancer.
off_label.summary: Metformin enhances immune T cell therapy for triple-negative breast cancer by boosting immune cell energy and strengthening tumor recognition.

off_label.title: MIG-6 Regulates HDAC1-Mediated Angiogenesis and Tumorigenesis in PTEN-Deficient Endometrioid Endometrial Cancer.
off_label.summary: MIG-6 suppresses endometrial cancer growth by blocking HDAC1, offering a potential new treatment target for this common gynecologic cancer.

off_label.title: Medium-Chain Fatty Acid Receptor GPR84 Modulates Cytotoxic CD8 T-cell Antitumor Immunity through Metabolic Reprogramming.
off_label.summary: Blocking GPR84 receptor boosts CD8 immune cells' ability to fight tumors by increasing their energy and cytotoxic function.

off_label.title: Rapid screening of potent and mechanistically insightful repurposable anticancer drugs targeting EGFR for non-small cell lung cancer: machine learning-aided and structure-guided approach.
off_label.summary: Researchers used machine learning to identify two existing drugs, idarubicin and larotrectinib, as potential treatments for EGFR-resistant lung cancer.

off_label.title: Anticancer Efficacy of HPPH-PDT Synergies with BCG-Immunotherapy or COX-2 Inhibitor in Treating Bladder Cancer.
off_label.summary: HPPH-PDT combined with COX-2 inhibitors or BCG immunotherapy significantly improves bladder cancer cure rates in mice.

off_label.title: Aspirin and other nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) for preventing colorectal cancer and colorectal adenoma in the general population.
off_label.summary: Aspirin and NSAIDs may help prevent colorectal cancer, but evidence remains unclear on whether benefits outweigh potential harms.

off_label.title: USP5 regulates purine metabolism and represents a therapeutic target in esophageal cancer.
off_label.summary: USP5 protein drives esophageal cancer growth by boosting guanine production; blocking it with mebendazole improves chemotherapy effectiveness.

off_label.title: Impact of NSAID type, initiation timing, duration and dose on clinical outcomes of immunotherapy in NSCLC: a multicenter two-cohort study.
off_label.summary: NSAID use patterns affect how well immunotherapy works in lung cancer patients, with implications for treatment outcomes.

off_label.title: Genome-Wide CRISPR Analysis Uncovers Metformin and NSAID Combination as a Chemopreventive Approach in Smoking-Associated Oral Cancer.
off_label.summary: Combining metformin and NSAIDs shows promise for preventing oral cancer in smokers by overcoming drug resistance.

off_label.title: Targeted nano delivery of p53 DNA and carvedilol for the treatment of dilated cardiomyopathy in a rat model.
off_label.summary: Researchers used specialized nanoparticles to deliver heart-protective genes and drugs directly to damaged heart tissue in rats.

off_label.title: Aldehyde dehydrogenase 1 A1 regulates the transcription of PD-L1 and its targeting with disulfiram together with PD-L1 immunotherapy synergistically delays cyst growth in ADPKD.
off_label.summary: Disulfiram combined with immunotherapy slows kidney cyst growth in polycystic kidney disease by targeting ALDH1A1.

off_label.title: Exploring the nexus: Clinical and physiological correlation between cardiovascular disease and colorectal cancer.
off_label.summary: Colorectal cancer and heart disease share common causes like inflammation and poor diet, suggesting integrated prevention strategies could reduce both conditions.

off_label.title: Repetitive fasting-refeeding enhances metformin-induced CXCR6+ CD8+ T cell tumor infiltration via VCAM-1 upregulation on normalized vasculature during refeeding.
off_label.summary: Combining metformin with repeated fasting cycles synergistically boosts tumor-fighting CD8+ T cells through improved blood vessel recruitment mechanisms.

off_label.title: Tenofovir Alafenamide Promotes Differentiation and Induces Apoptosis of AML Cells by Inhibiting Telomerase Reverse Transcriptase.
off_label.summary: Tenofovir Alafenamide shows promise against acute myeloid leukemia by blocking telomerase and triggering cancer cell death and differentiation.

biomarkers.title: Machine learning in the prediction of liver iron concentration and iron chelation therapy adjustment.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a machine learning algorithm to predict liver iron levels and help doctors adjust iron removal therapy doses.

biomarkers.title: TNS1 and TNS4 play a potential role in development of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma but not TNS2 and TNS3.
biomarkers.summary: TNS1 and TNS4 proteins may contribute to pancreatic cancer development and could serve as potential biomarkers for detection.

biomarkers.title: Mimicking Metastatic Renal Cell Carcinoma: A Case of Pancreatic Tail Neuroendocrine Neoplasm on 68Ga-LNC1007 PET/CT.
biomarkers.summary: A new PET scan technique successfully detected a pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor that conventional imaging missed, though it was initially mistaken for kidney cancer spread.

biomarkers.title: Large Gastric Pyloric Gland Adenoma Mimicking Malignancy on FDG PET/CT.
biomarkers.summary: A benign gastric pyloric gland adenoma can appear cancerous on imaging but is successfully treated with local surgical removal.

biomarkers.title: Atypical Imaging Features of Primary Peritoneal High-Grade Serous Carcinoma.
biomarkers.summary: Primary peritoneal serous cancer can present with unusual imaging features like coarse calcifications and a large mass without fluid buildup.

biomarkers.title: Tumor-Induced Osteomalacia Localized to an Abdominal Wall Phosphaturic Mesenchymal Tumor by 68Ga-DOTATATE PET/CT.
biomarkers.summary: PET/CT imaging successfully located a rare abdominal wall tumor causing bone disease, enabling surgical removal and patient recovery.

biomarkers.title: Aggressive Metastasis With Silent PET/CT: A Lesson From Well-differentiated Splenic Angiosarcoma.
biomarkers.summary: Well-differentiated splenic angiosarcoma can spread aggressively to the liver while remaining undetected on standard imaging scans.

biomarkers.title: Functional role of small extrachromosomal circular DNA in colorectal cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Small circular DNA molecules are abundant in colorectal cancer tumors and drive cancer-related gene overexpression, particularly CXCL5, correlating with poor survival.

biomarkers.title: Inflammatory arthritis irAE may represent a unique autoimmune disease primarily driven by T cells but likely not autoantibodies.
biomarkers.summary: Cancer immunotherapy-induced arthritis is driven by T cell activation rather than autoantibodies, unlike rheumatoid arthritis.

biomarkers.title: Identification of CD74-positive antigen presenting glioma cells in primary human tumors and murine models of NF1 high-grade glioma.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified CD74-positive glioma cells with antigen-presenting properties in NF1-associated high-grade brain tumors, enabling better mouse models for drug testing.

biomarkers.title: Concurrent Tissue and Circulating Tumor DNA analysis in Renal Cell Carcinoma: Insights from a Multimodal Database.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers found that blood tests detecting tumor DNA complement traditional tissue biopsies for monitoring kidney cancer mutations and treatment response.

biomarkers.title: The orexinergic system mediates the effects of ginsenoside Rg1 against cyclophosphamide-induced reproductive toxicity.
biomarkers.summary: Ginsenoside Rg1 protects male mice from chemotherapy-induced infertility by activating a specific cellular receptor in the testes.

biomarkers.title: CD28-Targeted Enzyme-Responsive Conformation-Switching Peptide Self-Assembly for Selective T-Cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (T-ALL) Therapy.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a targeted peptide therapy that selectively kills T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia cells by disrupting CD28 signaling and causing cell death.

biomarkers.title: Copper Depletion Nanoparticles Potentiate Cancer Immunotherapy by Avoiding Innate and Adaptive Immune Resistance.
biomarkers.summary: Copper-depleting nanoparticles reduce tumor immune resistance markers, enhancing immune cell attack on cancer while avoiding harmful side effects.

biomarkers.title: NUDT21 Drives T-Cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia Through Dual Regulation of Alternative Polyadenylation and Transcriptional Activation.
biomarkers.summary: NUDT21 protein drives T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia by controlling gene expression, and blocking it with a drug kills leukemia cells.

trials.title: Visualization of Cerebral Veins and Deep Gray Matter Nuclei by Susceptibility-weighted Imaging: A Comparative Study of 5.0 T and 3.0 T Imaging.
trials.summary: A 5.0 Tesla MRI scanner produces clearer images of brain veins and deep brain structures than a 3.0 Tesla scanner.

trials.title: Electroacupuncture improves cognitive function and neuropsychiatric symptoms in breast cancer survivors: a pilot randomized controlled trial.
trials.summary: Electroacupuncture treatment improved cognitive function and mental health symptoms in breast cancer survivors in a pilot study.

trials.title: CD28-Targeted Enzyme-Responsive Conformation-Switching Peptide Self-Assembly for Selective T-Cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (T-ALL) Therapy.
trials.summary: Researchers developed a targeted peptide therapy that selectively kills T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia cells by disrupting CD28 signaling and causing cell death.

trials.title: Copper Depletion Nanoparticles Potentiate Cancer Immunotherapy by Avoiding Innate and Adaptive Immune Resistance.
trials.summary: Copper-depleting nanoparticles reduce tumor immune resistance markers, enhancing immune cell attack on cancer while avoiding harmful side effects.

trials.title: Parameters predicting Recurrence after Focal Therapy for Prostate Cancer: Insights from a Multicenter Surveillance Database.
trials.summary: Researchers identified factors predicting recurrence in prostate cancer patients treated with focal therapy, a minimally invasive surgical approach.

trials.title: Clinical and histopathological predictors of disease progression in stage II cutaneous melanoma.
trials.summary: Researchers identified clinical and tissue features that predict which stage II melanoma patients will benefit most from new immunotherapy treatments.

trials.title: Identifying the optimal rapid antigen test for screening and determining the end of isolation: A modeling study.
trials.summary: Saliva-based rapid antigen tests reduce COVID-19 transmission risk more effectively than nasal-based tests for screening and isolation decisions.

trials.title: Sex specific disruptions in PKCγ signaling in a mouse model of Spinocerebellar Ataxia Type 14.
trials.summary: Researchers found that a PKCγ mutation causes ataxia more severely in male mice, suggesting sex-specific treatment strategies may help SCA14 patients.

trials.title: Role of Anti-GD2 Targeted PEG-b-PLGA Nanoparticles in the Treatment of MYCN Driven Neuroblastoma.
trials.summary: Targeted nanoparticles delivering dual drug inhibitors successfully reduced neuroblastoma tumor growth and increased cancer cell death in studies.

trials.title: Tescalcin is a phagocytic checkpoint driving immune escape and limiting immunotherapeutic efficacy in hepatocellular carcinoma.
trials.summary: Blocking tescalcin protein restores immune cells' ability to recognize and attack hepatocellular carcinoma, improving immunotherapy effectiveness.

trials.title: Pretreatment MRI as a Prognostic Factor After Radical Prostatectomy: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
trials.summary: MRI scans before prostate surgery may help predict which patients will have better or worse long-term outcomes.

trials.title: Alpelisib and Fulvestrant in PIK3CA-mutated hormone receptor-positive HER2-negative advanced breast cancer included in the German PRAEGNANT trial.
trials.summary: A real-world study examined alpelisib combined with fulvestrant for hormone receptor-positive breast cancer patients with PIK3CA mutations.

trials.title: Efficacy and safety of complement inhibitors and FcRn blockers in generalized AChR antibody-positive myasthenia gravis: a meta-analysis.
trials.summary: Complement inhibitors and FcRn blockers show promise as effective treatments for antibody-positive myasthenia gravis compared to standard care.

trials.title: Immune checkpoint inhibitor-related myocarditis in patients with thymic epithelial tumors: a retrospective cohort analysis.
trials.summary: Immune checkpoint inhibitor cancer drugs caused heart inflammation in some thymic tumor patients, a previously under-recognized side effect.

trials.title: Kidney function changes associated with trastuzumab use in women with breast cancer: a retrospective cohort study.
trials.summary: Trastuzumab, a breast cancer drug, may protect kidney function by reducing HER2 protein levels in women.

mind_body.title: Electroacupuncture improves cognitive function and neuropsychiatric symptoms in breast cancer survivors: a pilot randomized controlled trial.
mind_body.summary: Electroacupuncture treatment improved cognitive function and mental health symptoms in breast cancer survivors in a pilot study.

mind_body.title: Supportive Care Interventions in Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation: Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
mind_body.summary: Supportive care interventions like exercise, music, and stress management show promise for improving quality of life in blood cancer patients undergoing stem cell transplants.

mind_body.title: Effectiveness and Safety of Acupuncture for Cancer-Related Cognitive Impairment: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
mind_body.summary: Acupuncture may help improve thinking and memory problems caused by cancer and its treatments, though more rigorous research is needed.

mind_body.title: Music therapy interventions on symptom management in adults with advanced cancer - multisession longitudinal impact: systematic review.
mind_body.summary: Music therapy sessions may help reduce symptoms and improve quality of life in adults with advanced cancer receiving end-of-life care.

mind_body.title: Consensus Recommendations for Disease- and Treatment-Related Fatigue in Patients With Advanced Prostate Cancer: A Modified Delphi Panel.
mind_body.summary: Experts created guidelines to help doctors and advanced prostate cancer patients manage fatigue together through shared decision-making.

mind_body.title: Electroacupuncture Enhances Effectiveness of Omeprazole in Indomethacin-Induced Gastric Injury Mice via Nrf2 Activation and Vagus Nerve Conduction.
mind_body.summary: Electroacupuncture combined with omeprazole more effectively heals drug-induced stomach damage in mice than omeprazole alone.

mind_body.title: Application of Affective Touch in Patients With Advanced Cancer: Effects on Existential Distress, Pain, and Quality of Life.
mind_body.summary: Affective touch, a gentle hands-on therapy, reduced existential distress, pain, and improved quality of life in advanced cancer patients.

mind_body.title: Effectiveness of Mindfulness-Based Art Therapy for Oncology Nurses: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
mind_body.summary: Mindfulness-based art therapy reduces psychological stress in oncology nurses, improving their wellbeing and patient care quality.

mind_body.title: Acupoint catgut embedding ameliorates laparotomy-induced cognitive decline in aged mice by restoring gut microbiota.
mind_body.summary: Acupoint catgut embedding treatment reduced post-surgery cognitive decline in elderly mice by restoring healthy gut bacteria.

mind_body.title: Effects of manual acupuncture on microglial polarization and the Sirt1/NF-κB pathway in a rat model of post-stroke depression.
mind_body.summary: Acupuncture may treat post-stroke depression by reducing brain inflammation through immune cell regulation.

mind_body.title: Optimizing Postoperative Analgesia After Perianal Abscess Surgery Using Ultrasound-Guided Pudendal Nerve Block Combined with Wrist-Ankle Acupuncture: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
mind_body.summary: Ultrasound-guided nerve blocks combined with acupuncture effectively reduced pain after perianal abscess surgery compared to standard treatment alone.

mind_body.title: Developing and Evaluating an Inpatient Caregiver Support Program: Feasibility, Acceptability, and Perceived Impact.
mind_body.summary: A hospital program providing emotional support and guidance to family caregivers of seriously ill patients proved feasible, acceptable, and beneficial.

mind_body.title: Dual-Target SPG-Mandibular Neuromodulation for Post-Radiation Painful Trigeminal Neuropathy: A 7-Year Follow-up.
mind_body.summary: A 7-year study shows nerve stimulation effectively reduces chronic facial pain caused by radiation damage.

mind_body.title: Music in the Last Hours: Finding Humanity in the ICU.
mind_body.summary: Personalized music played at a cancer patient's bedside in the ICU reduced distress and provided comfort during final hours of life.

mind_body.title: Intolerance of uncertainty and attitudes toward cancer as predictors of spiritual well-being in patients with cancer.
mind_body.summary: Cancer patients' spiritual well-being is predicted by their tolerance of uncertainty and their attitudes toward their cancer diagnosis.
